title: PagesCollectionResponse
description: Response payload for the BigCommerce API.

ResponseMeta.description: Data about the response, including pagination and collection totals.

pagination.description: Data about the response, including pagination and collection totals.

total.description: Total number of items in the result set.

count.description: Total number of items in the collection response.

per_page.description: The amount of items returned in the collection per page, controlled by the limit parameter.

current_page.description: The page you are currently on within the collection.

total_pages.description: The total number of pages in the collection.

links.description: Pagination links for the previous and next parts of the whole collection.

previous.description: Link to the previous page returned in the response.

current.description: Link to the current page returned in the response.

next.description: Link to the next page returned in the response.

anyTypePage.description: Properties of all Pages V3 pages.

name.description: The name of the page. Must be unique.

is_visible.description: A boolean value that controls whether the page is available to users or visible in any navigation menus.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent page, if any.

sort_order.description: Determines the order in which the page is displayed in the parent page’s menu. Pages with lower integers display earlier.

type.description: Determines the type of page. See [Pages v3 page types](/docs/rest-content/pages#page-types) for more about the differences.

is_homepage.description: Determines whether this page loads at the siteʼs root route. For example, at `https://example.com/`.

is_customers_only.description: When `true`, this page is not visible to merchant users who are signed in to the store control panel.

url.description: Relative URL on the storefront for this page.

meta_keywords.description: Comma-separated list of SEO-relevant keywords to include in the element of this page.

meta_description.description: Description contained within the element of this page.

search_keywords.description: Comma-separated list of keywords that shoppers can use to locate this page when searching the store.

url.description: Relative URL on the storefront for this page.

email.description: Applicable when the page type is `contact_form`: contact email address that receives messages sent via the form. Must be unique.

contact_fields.description:
A comma-separated list of the contact field forms that are enabled in the store control panel for display on the subject storefront. Possible fields include:

| Field | Description |
|:|:|
| `fullname` | The full name of the customer submitting the form. |
| `phone` | The customer’s phone number. |
| `companyname` | The customer’s company name. |
| `orderno` | A field that lets customers specify a subject order number. |
| `rma` | A customer’s submitted RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) number. |

feed.description: The URL of the RSS feed. Required in a `POST` request if the page type is `rss_feed`.

link.description: The link for the page type `link`.

typePage.description: Schema for a Pages V3 page with `type: page`

body.description: HTML or variable that populates the element of this page, in default/desktop view. Required in a `POST` request if the page type is `raw`.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the page body.
